newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London shrug off weak Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London shrug off weak Tokyo.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London edged higher in thin dealings on Monday, lifted by moderate buying in car stocks and selected large caps, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London was up 3.74 points at 1,377.20 in late afternoon trade, shrugging off a 0.3 percent drop in Tokyo's Nikkei 225 index to 20,107.11 earlier today.
The market was expected to hold steady to the end of the day and remain well supported on Tuesday, traders said.

"Trades are thin here but there's a general feeling 20,000 is going to hold, with 19,500 slated as a good buy level," a London trader of Japanese equities said. Traders said activity had been dulled by the U.S. Labor Day holiday.
